expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Identity rotation constant (0, 0, 0, 1). Builds a quaternion from Euler angles in degrees. Fast shortest-path linear interpolation; the result is not normalized. @param Alpha Interpolation fraction; 0 uses A and 1 uses B. Fast bilinear quaternion interpolation; the result is not normalized. @param FracX Horizontal interpolation fraction. @param FracY Vertical interpolation fraction. Shortest-path spherical interpolation without normalizing the result. @param Slerp Interpolation fraction; 0 uses Quat1 and 1 uses Quat2. Shortest-path spherical interpolation with a normalized result. @param Slerp Interpolation fraction; 0 uses Quat1 and 1 uses Quat2. Returns normalized rotational error between normalized quaternions. Normalizes both inputs before returning their normalized rotational error. Full-path spherical interpolation without result normalization. @param Slerp Interpolation fraction; 0 uses Quat1 and 1 uses Quat2. Full-path spherical interpolation without shortest-path correction. @param Slerp Interpolation fraction; 0 uses Quat1 and 1 uses Quat2.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value.
inputs: Explicit arguments for every overload, default-argument omission where published, and valid/null context variants when handles or WorldContext are involved.
